t: Paper activities where students build a small language model and generate text with dice.
steps: Find LLMs Unplugged from Ben Swift at the ANU School of Cybernetics.
Try the 20-minute self-guided version yourself first.
Choose a lesson or workshop that fits your time.
Print the sheets or cutouts from the site.
Gather pens, paper, and dice. Use a d10 for the grid activities.
Check the content license stated on the site.
Run the activity and let students generate text from their model.
